facts.value: Under the student advisory service, students of the Department of Economics receive support and advice on various issues regarding their studies.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: The E! Week with its mentoring program is the ideal start to studies for all bachelor students. In a three-day program, first-year students get to know Goethe University, the department, our campus life, and the city of Frankfurt.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: Our master's students are warmly welcomed at the Master Welcome Day and receive important information.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: The event series 'Bachelor meets Business' aims to create a forum for the exchange between science and practice. It invites an exciting selection of companies every winter semester. Master's students are also welcome.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: The Dean's List aims to honor outstanding academic achievements and simultaneously bring students and companies into contact. This special honor from the dean is awarded each semester to the best bachelor and master's students.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: All bachelor and master's graduates receive an invitation to the graduation celebration, where the graduation is traditionally celebrated with gowns.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL
